title: Design spec: instrumented dogfooding run of sec-overlay
summary: Approved design spec for an instrumented dogfooding run of sec-overlay across three target repos, defining method, watch checklist, issue taxonomy, and fix gates.
notes: Self-titled 'Design spec' with Status: Approved. Defines execution contract (method, per-phase checks, constraints) rather than a single ADR decision or user-facing PRD requirements → SPEC. No frontmatter; content signals only. No Bash tool available, so filename suffix is a path-derived slug, not a SHA-256 prefix.
